## Purpose
This repository contains self-contained, zero-dependency Python stdlib micro-applications and the STIR+IESCS Agentic Wire Protocol SDK (`000-stir-iescs-protocol-sdk`). Note: The Creative Liberation Engine lives exclusively in `https://github.com/WholeTroutMedia/creative-liberation-engine`. Read `registry/applications.json` and each module's `AGENT_BLUEPRINT.json` + `SKILL.md` for capability descriptors and synthesis recipes.

## Available Modules
- [000-stir-iescs-protocol-sdk](./apps/000-stir-iescs-protocol-sdk/AGENT_BLUEPRINT.json): STIR + IESCS Agentic Wire Protocol & Plain-English Receipt SDK (`X-Inception-Rosetta-Upgrade: STIR-IESCS/1.0`, Kleene ternary `{-1, 0, +1}` framing, CRC32C integrity, and plain-English human receipts).
- [001-seal-pdf-media-notary](./apps/001-seal-pdf-media-notary/AGENT_BLUEPRINT.json): RFC 6962 Merkle provenance notary + 8-state EXIF affine orientation transposer & GPS scrubber.
- [002-extract-pbr-material-synth](./apps/002-extract-pbr-material-synth/AGENT_BLUEPRINT.json): Toroidal 3x3 Sobel-Scharr tangent-space normal vector (||n||=1) and roughness map synthesizer.
- [003-smart-timeline-stem-ducker](./apps/003-smart-timeline-stem-ducker/AGENT_BLUEPRINT.json): Rational-frame FCPXML 1.10 NLE timeline compiler with -18.0dB dialogue ducking keyframes.
